tenants.status: CreateTenant is disabled pending the workspace-admission decision DEC-01; no actor may use it until the chosen authority is reconciled. SuspendTenant/CloseTenant/RestoreTenant require platform tenant administration. Suspension/closure stops new admissions but preserves accepted-work recovery and exports. Existing configured tenants remain usable; isolated test tenancy is separately provisioned by fixture credentials.
memberships.status: Invitation token matches current unused nonexpired invitation; access changes require tenant admin and revoke grants when membership ceases to be active.
driver_relationships.status: Tenant owns this relationship; invitation acceptance authenticates the invited driver; ending/suspending cannot erase active physical obligations or global driver identity.
tenant_subscriptions.state: Billing status comes from an authenticated provider receipt or the recorded due/cancellation schedule; preserve active-work recovery on entitlement loss.
verification_applications.state: Application and evidence revision belong to the authenticated applicant; a reviewed provider/human decision applies only to the current submitted revision. Verification provider gate must be enabled.
verification_evidence.state: Upload session is bound to applicant/application/purpose; only server-verified hash, MIME and current revision qualify as verified. Replacement preserves prior evidence.
payout_methods.verification_state: Method belongs to the driver; current verification intent must match the authenticated provider receipt. No receipt alone initiates a payment.
vehicles.status: Tenant controls vehicle; unavailable/maintenance/archive prevents new assignments; active obligations must be explicitly resolved before archive.
freelance_vehicles.status: Only owner changes vehicle metadata; verified state requires approved current evidence. Material edits invalidate approval. Archive requires zero unresolved vehicle commitments.
shift_occurrences.state: Relationship and vehicle are eligible for the interval; exact start/end and break rules apply. No-show applies only to a scheduled unstarted shift; overlapping active shifts reject.
slot_occurrences.admission_state: Use resolved site/brand/city precedence and server-local service date. Closed follows explicit override; overcommitted means live held+committed units exceed resolved cap; superseded never admits new work.
slot_reservations.state: Server clock owns expiry; lock occurrence and draft before checking capacity. Refresh cannot exceed maximum lifetime; move counts destination before releasing original hold; committed reservation belongs to one delivery.
source_connections.state: Connection belongs to tenant; credentials and provider-specific adapter must be enabled and validated. Paused/disconnected connections admit no new ingestion; unknown credentials never imply active.
source_events.state: Verify connection, signature, timestamp and dedupe key before received. Normalize to canonical draft; apply only safe current revision; changed physical/address scope needs review. Conflicting reuse of provider ID is quarantined.
intake_batches.state: Batch owner and immutable source references match; extract individual drafts before review. Commit processes only explicitly approved current child revisions, recording each child outcome and preserving failed drafts.
intake_drafts.review_state: Current draft revision and original source are preserved; extraction proposes changes only. Address review alone stays review_needed. Ready also requires required-field and configured address/timing-policy validation; commit independently requires a live applicable reservation for named slots or configured direct-window admission.
address_suggestions.state: Suggestion binds exact draft/address revision. Accept/edit/reject is an explicit operator decision; stale extraction cannot overwrite a newer manual edit.
location_observations.state: Observation binds location and evidence cause. A reviewer may accept a verified entrance; recipient absence alone is not evidence of an incorrect entrance.
deliveries.readiness: Readiness depends on required address/content review and unresolved operational holds. Issue resolution restores ready only when those requirements are satisfied; it does not establish goods preparation.
deliveries.preparation_state: Merchant/operator reports preparation for the current manifest. Unknown means preparation has not been confirmed; ready is distinct from actual inbound receipt and custody.
deliveries.outcome: Aggregate current fulfillment-unit quantities under delivery/manifest-line locks. Delivered means every ordered unit delivered; mixed delivered/cancelled is partially_delivered. Returned or cancelled requires the matching disposition of all undelivered quantities.
deliveries.evidence_state: Derive from required proof for every fulfilled portion. Physical handoff remains independent. Evidence disputes affect only their targeted proof; completion cannot invent missing media.
plans.state: Proposal matches immutable ID/version=1, source plan version, input/policy hashes and expiry. New generation preserves saved work until explicit apply; superseding never removes executed history.
rounds.state: Current whole-delivery assignments and accepted scope must match. Released permits execution only subject to the live gate. Completion requires this Round’s complete deliveries and actual proof/return obligations; other separate orders do not block it.
rounds.departure_gate: Derive synchronously in the affecting transaction: hold/address/vehicle/consent => blocked; conflicting receipt => discrepancy; unreceived required unit quantities => awaiting_receipt; unprepared => awaiting_preparation; otherwise ready. Recheck on physical commands.
stops.state: Stop belongs to current assignment. Dropoff identifies a fulfillment unit; pickup/return/transfer identify the correct physical obligation. No navigation or arrival message establishes receipt or handoff.
assignments.state: Exactly one live assignment for a Round. Own-team acknowledgement differs from freelance consent. Device receipt changes only received_at/state; accepted work creates assignment atomically, not after notification delivery.
driver_commitments.state: Lock driver conflict guard and reject interval overlap. Commitment covers promised execution including return/reload. Withdrawal releases only future reserved range and cannot erase custody.
delivery_attempts.state: Attempt belongs to one collected fulfillment unit and current/historical authorized assignment. Completion requires this portion’s handoff and verified proof; remaining units on other work do not block it.
handoffs.state: Record actual receiver, quantity and custody movement once. Physical corrections are append-only evidence decisions, never an effect of a payment-only dispute.
assets.state: Reservation scope, expiry, byte count/hash and scan result must match. Uploaded is not verified; expired/infected assets cannot satisfy proof.
proof_submissions.state: Submission binds exact attempt/handoff/policy and verified assets. Complete requires all required proof items. Evidence reviewer may uphold previous valid proof or reject and request genuine replacement; financial decisions cannot change validity.
proof_items.state: Server verifies asset hash, MIME, policy purpose and receiver attribution. Replacement or receiver change invalidates only affected evidence; keep original bytes and review history.
issues.state: Issue applies to authorized delivery/attempt/driver scope. Decision records concrete action and actor; resolved only when required receipt/change/evidence action actually completes.
return_tasks.state: Return manifest and lines belong to the delivery; custodian balances and receiver identity match. Partial receipts increment actual quantities only; receipt discrepancy cannot fabricate a returned balance.
change_proposals.state: Team instruction applies immediately with acknowledgement; freelance proposal applies only on current accepted response before expiry. Decline/withdraw/expiry retains prior agreement.
broadcasts.state: Operator starts or restarts explicitly. Only opted-in eligible freelancers are candidates; own-driver capacity is never a start gate. Acceptance is a single-winner transaction under current scope/hash/deadline.
broadcast_waves.state: Wave uses captured nearest-first policy and server deadlines. Activate only scheduled current wave while broadcast searching; close at deadline or winner; stop cancels remaining waves.
offers.state: Only offered driver may accept/decline current offer. Acceptance before expiry wins exclusive unit claims and driver range; other drivers’ offers become taken. A losing response never marks itself accepted.
freelance_agreements.state: Accepted immutable scope and fare form the agreement. Complete only agreed units and duties; cancel through authorized compensation/consent path. Disputes are separate records and do not overwrite completed work.
settlement_records.state: Open settlement records independent earning/payment facts. Close only final entitlement established, financial disputes resolved and due/refund_due zero. Cancellation with prepayment still requires refund accounting before closure.
settlement_records.earning_state: Unearned until current agreed portion completes or authorized compensable cancellation establishes earnings; void only when no earned entitlement remains. Recording payment cannot earn money.
settlement_records.payment_state: Derive net payments minus refunds against current nonnegative entitlement: zero=unpaid, between zero and entitlement=partially_paid, equal=paid, greater=overpaid. Use integer minor units and one currency.
transport_trips.state: Origin/destination, vehicle and driver scope match; loaded quantities are real custody. Departure requires actual load and holds cleared; arrival is not receipt; close requires every booked line received or explicitly resolved.
trip_bookings.state: Booking lines belong to its delivery manifest. Compare incremental loaded/received quantities with booked quantities; partial load must remain receivable without fabricating missing goods.
trip_receipts.state: Append authenticated receiver’s actual quantities and condition once per command. Immutable receipt state describes this receipt snapshot; later increments create new receipts.
messages.state: Received means stored on server; delivered needs recipient-device acknowledgement; read needs recipient action. Local sending/uploading are client states, not server message states.
call_sessions.state: Call provider gate enabled; parties authorized for current conversation; verified provider session receipt owns ringing/connected/ended. Decline is callee action; missed means ringing deadline elapsed without connection.
notification_deliveries.state: Intent is unique by event/recipient/channel/kind. Provider accepted is not delivered. Unknown timeout reconciles original provider identity before resend; template edits do not change dedupe identity.
writeback_tasks.state: Enabled adapter and exact delivery/source revision required. On ambiguous provider result reconcile original idempotency identity; retry cannot rewrite changed commercial or physical source facts.
navigation_intents.state: Intent belongs to current driver/stop and permitted vehicle profile. Device open acknowledgement is not arrival. Supersede old intent when route changes; expire at stored deadline.
command_receipts.state: Admit one canonical hash per command ID. Committed receipt stores complete result atomically with domain facts; conflicting retry rejects; retained evidence is not successful current-work mutation.
outbox_events.state: Lease claim is conditional on due queued/retry row; acknowledge only successful consumer receipt. Expired lease permits retry of the same dedupe identity, never a new business effect.
account_outbox.state: Private account event remains principal-scoped; use conditional lease and durable consumer receipts. Tenant dispatch streams cannot receive account-only payloads.
job_runs.state: Stable job key identifies source event or scheduled occurrence. Claim lease atomically, retry within budget, and finish only after durable effect. Cancel queued work only, not an unknown external effect.
export_jobs.state: Requester retains current permission for selected tenant/cities; output contains only allowed fields. Ready requires complete private asset; download token expires separately; revoked access denies download.
privacy_requests.state: Verify subject and authorized reviewer. Holds defer affected deletion; approved execution uses bounded audited retention path; mark completed only after all permitted stores/exports are handled.
custody_transfers.state: Sender owns requested balance; named receiver alone confirms or declines. Decline/cancel/expiry before any receipt leaves custody at source. Partial receipt conserves outstanding source quantity.
remaining_obligations.state: Historical split-work state family only, not executable launch work. No launch command creates or plans a pickup remainder. Legacy residual records require supervised migration/incident disposition and may not be converted into new independent delivery portions. Real damage, shortage and partial return/receipt observations remain truthful under issues/returns/custody, not split delivery execution.
inbound_dependencies.state: Compute required quantities for each destination unit against authentic undamaged receipts. Missing one unit blocks only its dependent routes. ETA changes never imply receipt.
fulfillment_units.state: Exactly one internal unit contains every current manifest line of one customer delivery. No split, child, residual unit or independent portion assignment at launch. CommitDelivery creates that whole unit; ConfirmPickup only changes an existing open whole unit to collected after full line equality, preparation readiness and actual inbound availability. Collected allocation is frozen. Delivered requires complete actual handoff and verified required proof; returned/cancelled require actual custody disposition. Preserve original delivery identity.
dispute_cases.state: Kind selects authority and allowed outcomes. Financial case changes only ledger adjustments; evidence case targets a proof with prior validity recorded. Close only after authorized effects commit.
